user.title: Connect a Lumi curtain
user.description: Supports lumi.curtain.hmcn02. Close Mi Home and the Bluetooth control page, then enter the curtain's Bluetooth address and 32-byte LTMK (64 hexadecimal characters). A connectable Bluetooth adapter with ATT MTU of at least 69 is required.

reauth_confirm.title: Update curtain credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The curtain rejected its saved LTMK. Enter the current 32-byte LTMK.

error.invalid_address: Enter a Bluetooth address such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.invalid_ltmk: The LTMK must be exactly 64 hexadecimal characters.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to communicate with the curtain. Check Bluetooth range and adapter MTU support, and close other apps connected to the curtain. After a failed login, wait about 20 seconds before retrying.
